title: The Presence Bottleneck: Domain Adaptation and Low-End Deployment of SAM3

headline.label: RAM to run SAM3 after INT8 quantization, with no measurable accuracy loss

points: Re-evaluated SAM3 domain adaptation and efficiency methods under a pre-registered protocol, with bootstrap CIs and matched controls.
A data-free prompt-embedding rebalancing raised underwater segmentation by +0.090 mIoU.
INT8 quantization runs SAM3 in 657 MB / 2.5 GB RAM with no measurable accuracy loss.
Output-level knowledge distillation raised a small backbone from 0.339 to 0.486 mIoU at the same size and speed.
tldr: Taught a big segmentation model to see underwater, then put it on a diet.

title: From Prompt to Kinematics: Self-Verifying Generation of Valid, Controllable Robot Models

headline.label: pass@1 with zero invalid models, vs. 0.32 for direct LLM generation

points: An agentic LLM system that writes MuJoCo (MJCF) robot models from text or reference images.
After every edit, a verifier compiles the model and step-probes it for instability.
pass@1 = 0.92 with zero invalid models on a 25-prompt benchmark, compared with 0.32 for direct LLM generation.
Includes a vision-based judge that scores geometry and pose.
tldr: The LLM designs the robot. A very strict verifier stops it from lying about physics.

title: Certified Records: An Exact Audit of AI-Claimed Mathematical Constructions

headline.label: “new best-known” record claims from 10 AI discovery systems, re-verified exactly

points: Re-verified 115 “new best-known” record claims from 10 AI discovery systems (incl. AlphaEvolve) in exact rational and interval arithmetic.
Found printed values that do not hold, records that do not beat earlier public constructions, and a leaderboard verifier exploit (true score 0.214 vs. 0.563 displayed).
Computer-assisted existence proofs for 61 spherical t-designs (Krawczyk interval-Newton).
tldr: I fact-checked the AIs doing maths. Floating point had some explaining to do.

title: Rotation-Robust Bangla Sign Language Recognition from a Wrist-Referenced 6-IMU Glove

headline.label: macro-F1 drop under an SO(3) rotation stress test (baselines lost 0.82–0.87)

points: Built an ESP32 glove with six MPU6050 IMUs.
Measuring finger orientation relative to the wrist makes the features exactly invariant to global hand rotation.
Zero macro-F1 drop under an SO(3) rotation stress test across RF, SVM and a CNN–BiLSTM–attention model. Absolute-orientation baselines lost 0.82–0.87.
tldr: Hold your hand however you like. The glove genuinely does not care.
